title: Marsha's on South Street Reaches Its Final Weekend
summary: The popular women's sports bar on South Street in Philadelphia is closing its doors this weekend.

sections.text: Patrons of Marsha's on South Street are facing the final days of operation for the local women's sports bar. According to reports from NBC10 Philadelphia, this weekend marks the end of business for the establishment.
The venue has served as a notable gathering space in the city. However, ownership or management has decided to permanently shut down the location, drawing patrons out for one last weekend of service.

Details regarding the closure beyond this weekend have not been provided. Residents and supporters are utilizing the remaining time to visit the South Street establishment before it officially closes.

title: Savannah Bananas Announce First-Ever San Antonio Games for 2027
summary: The Savannah Bananas are scheduled to play in San Antonio for the first time in 2027, according to recent local reports.

sections.text: Baseball fans in San Antonio can look forward to an upcoming visit from the popular exhibition team, according to recent local news reports from KSAT.
The scheduled games will mark the very first time the Savannah Bananas perform in the area. Specific dates, venues, and ticket details have not yet been publicly released by organizers.
The team is widely recognized for its entertaining style of play and growing nationwide following. Local supporters will need to wait for further announcements as the 2027 season approaches.
